# Project Overview

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Purpose

ms-mni (image `sim-mni`, `ecr-push.sh`) queries Brazilian court MNI/PJe SOAP webservices per `Tribunal`, persists processos, partes, movimentos and documentos in PostgreSQL + S3, and serves them to token-authenticated clients through a REST API, PDF exports and periodic monitoring with webhooks.

### Business problem

- Each tribunal exposes its own MNI SOAP endpoints (`tribunais.url_webservice_mni*` columns) → clients call one REST API (`routes/api.php`) instead of N SOAP services.
- MNI/PJe returns raw machine errors (`"exception invoking: loginFailed"`) → `App\Services\MNI\PadronizarMensagemMniService` rewrites them before they reach API responses, webhooks and the dashboard.
- Re-querying the tribunal on every read is slow → processo data is cached in the DB; reads return the stored copy and refresh in background (`BaixarProcessoMNIJob`).
- Clients need to know when a processo changes → `POST /api/processo/monitoramentos` schedules polling every `intervalo_horas` (1–720) and fires webhook `processo.monitoramento.executado` on every run (README "Monitoramento periódico de processos").
- Clients need one consolidated PDF of a processo's documents → `POST /api/processo/download` export pipeline with callback.
- PJe credentials vary per caller → accepted per request, stored encrypted per monitoramento (`credenciais_pje`, cast `encrypted`), or taken from env default pair `PJE_LOGIN_PADRAO`/`PJE_SENHA_PADRAO`.

### Consumers and integrations

| System | Role |
|---|---|
| API clients (rows in `api_tokens`, header `X-API-Token`) | Call `/api/*`; receive webhooks on their `callback_url` |
| Tribunal MNI SOAP webservices | Upstream source: `consultarProcesso`, `consultarAvisosPendentes`, `consultarTeorComunicacao`, `entregarManifestacaoProcessual`, `consultarAssuntosJudiciais`, `consultarClassesJudiciais`, ... (`app/Services/MNI/`) |
| Comunica PJe REST `https://comunicaapi.pje.jus.br/api/v1/comunicacao` | Client `App\Services\ComunicacaoPJe\ConsultarProcessoService`; injected into `Api\ConsultarProcessoController`, no call to `execute()` found under `app/` |
| AWS S3 (`Storage::disk('s3')`) | Document binaries `documentos-processos/...`, export PDFs `downloads/...`, 60-min presigned links |
| Admin users (session auth, Inertia React UI) | Manage tribunais and API tokens; view dashboard, monitoramentos, processos (`routes/web.php`) |
| Redis + Laravel Horizon | Queue backend for 5 supervisors (`config/horizon.php`) |
| Sentry, Discord | Error tracking and `discord` log channel (`config/sentry.php`, `config/logging.php`) |
| Coolify | Production deploy webhook (`.github/workflows/deploy-production.yaml`) |

### Macro flow

Synchronous consulta (`GET /api/processo/visualizar`):

1. Client sends `X-API-Token` + `tribunal_id` + `numero_processo` (+ optional `login_pje`/`senha_pje`).
2. `ValidateApiToken` hashes the token (sha256), loads a valid `ApiToken`, stores it as request attribute `apiToken`; else 401.
3. `InjectCredenciaisPjePadrao` replaces an incomplete credential pair with `config('pje.credenciais_padrao')` (or nulls).
4. Controller normalizes `numero_processo` (`cleanNumeroProcesso`) and looks up `Processo` by (`numero_processo`, `tribunal_id`).
5. Missing → `ProcessoService::consultarNumero` calls SOAP `consultarProcesso` (default `dataReferencia` = 90 days ago), upserts dados básicos, partes, movimentos, documentos; each non-`baixado` documento → `BaixarDocumentoMNIJob` on queue `mni-download`.
6. Present → `BaixarProcessoMNIJob` refresh dispatched; stored copy returned immediately.
7. Response: processo JSON with tribunal, partes.representantesProcessual, prioridades, classe, assuntos, movimentos, documentos.
8. Background jobs write binaries to S3 `documentos-processos/{numero_processo}/{id_documento}.{ext}`; `GET /api/documento/visualizar` returns a 60-min presigned `link`.

Monitoring flow (`monitoramentos:despachar` → `ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob` → `EnviarWebhookMonitoramentoJob`) and export flow (`GerarPdfExportacaoJob` → `EnviarParaS3ExportacaoJob` → `EnviarWebhookDownloadJob`) → see [`architecture.md`](architecture.md).

### Out of scope

- Monitoring runs never download document binaries: `ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob` calls `consultarNumero(..., false)`; README: "Documentos entram só como metadados".
- API never returns PJe credentials: `MonitoramentoResource` exposes only `credencial.uuid` + `credencial.login_mascarado`.
- Export format limited to `pdf`: `CriarExportacaoProcessoRequest` rule `Rule::in(['pdf'])`.
- Monitoramento `PATCH` cannot cancel: `status` accepts only `ativo`/`pausado`; cancel = `DELETE` (`AtualizarMonitoramentoProcessoRequest`).
